basis: EXTRAPOLATED: concept 10.7 Loki-era logs (not VictoriaLogs); 8 spans and 3.2 log lines/request, tail sampling on. Traffic cores/memory are incremental; exclude idle base, query peaks, app and control-plane resources. Series: 2520/service + 60/pod; metrics ingest memory 0.6–1.1 KB/series, disk 5.3 GB/day/M series at 30s. Bucket total uses rounded 21 GB/day (components 16.6 + 4.0); VictoriaLogs has no bucket. Class A/B are traffic write-path estimates only; profile operations and read workload not measured.
